# telnyx_dynamic_emergency_endpoints (Data Source)

Lists dynamic emergency endpoints, with optional filters. Each item has the attributes of `telnyx_dynamic_emergency_endpoint`.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filter_country_code` (String) Filter by country code.
- `filter_status` (String) Filter by status. One of `activated`, `pending`, `rejected`.
- `max_items` (Number) Stop reading after this many items. By default every page is read.

### Read-Only

- `dynamic_emergency_endpoints` (Attributes List) The objects, in the order the API returns them. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--dynamic_emergency_endpoints))

<a id="nestedatt--dynamic_emergency_endpoints"></a>
### Nested Schema for `dynamic_emergency_endpoints`

Read-Only:

- `callback_number` (String)
- `caller_name` (String)
- `created_at` (String) ISO 8601 formatted date of when the resource was created
- `dynamic_emergency_address_id` (String) An id of a currently active dynamic emergency location.
- `id` (String)
- `record_type` (String) Identifies the type of the resource.
- `sip_from_id` (String)
- `status` (String) Status of dynamic emergency address
- `updated_at` (String) ISO 8601 formatted date of when the resource was last updated
